Build a normalized eICU diagnosis ICD parquet table from CSV files

Source: R/eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet.R
build_eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet.Rd

eICU stores one or more comma-separated ICD codes in diagnosis.icd9code and does not provide an explicit ICD version. This utility expands those codes to one row per diagnosis-code pair, joins patient-level identifiers, resolves each code's ICD version, and writes a standalone parquet file for audit and inspection.

Usage

build_eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet(
  diagnosis_csv,
  patient_csv,
  icd_dict_path,
  output_path,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  icd_adjudication_path = NULL
)

Arguments

diagnosis_csv

Path to eICU diagnosis.csv or diagnosis.csv.gz.

patient_csv

Path to eICU patient.csv or patient.csv.gz.

icd_dict_path

Path to diagnosis dictionary CSV/RDS with icd_code, icd_version (9 or 10), and optionally long_title.

output_path

Destination parquet file, or a directory where diagnosis_icd_mod.parquet should be written.

overwrite

Overwrite an existing parquet file? Default FALSE.

icd_adjudication_path

Optional reviewed eICU ICD-version crosswalk. Defaults to the packaged crosswalk, as in the pipeline.

Value

Invisibly returns the written parquet file path.

Details

Versions are resolved by the package's single eICU resolver - the same one used for cohort selection, cohort_info, comorbidities and ISS - so every code gets exactly the version the pipeline gives it: an exact match of the dotted token against the dictionary, a compact match only for tokens written without a dot, then an approved expert adjudication. Codes that are official in both versions stay ambiguous, and codes that match nothing stay unmatched; neither gets a version. There is no regular-expression fallback: a regex guess is reported separately, in regex_version_suggestion, for diagnosis only. This utility is not the canonical eICU cohort selector and does not determine cohort membership.

Output columns include icd_code_raw (the source token), icd_code (compact), icd_version ("9", "10" or NA), version_source (the resolution status: exact_dotted, compact_unique, expert_adjudicated, ambiguous, unmatched or malformed), is_ambiguous, match_n and long_titles_all (the dictionary candidates the evidence points to, so ambiguity stays visible), long_title, and regex_version_suggestion.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
build_eicu_diagnosis_icd_parquet(
  diagnosis_csv = "data/source_data/eicu/diagnosis.csv.gz",
  patient_csv = "data/source_data/eicu/patient.csv.gz",
  icd_dict_path = system.file("extdata", "d_icd_diagnoses.csv", package = "rendehR"),
  output_path = "data/eicu_diagnosis_icd.parquet")
} # }
